title: Mediterranean Baked Fish Tray
seoTitle: Mediterranean Baked Fish Tray | Firefighter Meal
shortDescription: White fish with cherry tomatoes, olives, and capers on one sheet
subtitle: White fish with cherry tomatoes, olives, and capers on one sheet
description: Cod or halibut bakes with cherry tomatoes, Kalamata olives, capers, garlic, and olive oil until flaky. Designed for hall-scale portioning.

steps.title: Heat oven and toss vegetables
steps.instruction: Heat oven to 400°F. Toss tomatoes, olives, capers, onion, garlic, oregano, half the olive oil, and salt on two half-sheets until evenly coated.

steps.title: Season fish
steps.instruction: Pat fish dry. Nest fillets among vegetables. Drizzle remaining oil and lemon juice over fish so surfaces look lightly glossed.

steps.title: Roast until flaky
steps.instruction: Roast 16–20 minutes until fish reads 145°F and flakes with gentle pressure. Tomatoes should burst and release juice into the pan.

steps.title: Finish with lemon and herbs
steps.instruction: Top with lemon slices and parsley. Fish flesh should look opaque and moist, not chalky or separating into dry strands.

steps.title: Portion with pan juices
steps.instruction: Serve each fillet with a spoonful of tomato-olive mixture and pan juices spooned over the top for brightness.

proTips: Do not use fish thinner than 1 inch—it overcooks before tomatoes soften.
Add crumbled feta after baking for extra salt and creaminess.
Crusty bread for sopping pan juices keeps crew happy without extra cooking.
tonightSpread: Simple arugula salad with shaved parmesan.
leftovers: Flake fish into a Mediterranean grain salad next day.
Fish tacos with leftover tomato-olive mix as salsa.
whyCrewsLikeIt: Light but satisfying after heavy training days. Minimal dishes and big flavor from pantry staples.
mealPrepNotes: Pit olives if needed. Keep fish cold until it hits the oven. Station: Use parchment on half-sheets for fish release without sticking. Station: Nest fish between tomatoes so fillets stay moist during high-heat roast. Station: Spoon pan juices over portions at the line for extra flavor.
